g1.label: Subject: ___
g1.why: A subject line should say clearly what the email is about.

g2.label: …since Monday, ___ the flat is very cold.
g2.why: So introduces the result: the heating is broken, so the flat is cold.

g3.label: …called the helpline, ___ nobody has come yet.
g3.why: But shows contrast: you called, and nobody came.

g4.label: Could you please send someone ___ Friday?
g4.why: By Friday means no later than Friday.

g5.label: I look forward ___ hearing from you.
g5.why: The fixed phrase is look forward to + -ing.

g6.label: 6. …move my seminar group, ___ we have a clash…
g6.why: Because gives the reason for the request.

g7.label: 7. … ___, it is booked all day on Tuesday.
g7.why: However shows contrast with the sentence before.

g8.label: 8. … ___, could you send me the slides?
g8.why: Also adds a second request to the first.

g9.label: 9. Please find the form ___ to this email.
g9.why: The fixed phrase is please find the form attached.

g10.label: 10. I apologise for any ___.
g10.why: After any, use the noun inconvenience.
